description: A small stack of bright plastic plates and a scattered pile of colorful plastic forks and spoons sit on the table, with a yellow bottle and a blue sponge off to the right. The left hand holds and steadies the green plate near the center while the right hand uses the blue sponge as a right-hand object to wipe across the plate and over the utensils, then slides the sponge to the right side and releases it as both hands continue nudging and gathering the utensils into a neater pile.
